title: Beef Casserole in Russian-Style
description: A hearty Chinese-inspired casserole with beef and pungent flavors. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet or wok, heat the oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the five-spice powder and cook for 1 minute.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together the beef broth, soy sauce, and sugar.
6. In a greased 9x13-inch casserole dish, arrange half of the beef mixture.
7. Pour half of the broth mixture over the beef.
8. Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining beef and then the remaining broth mixture.
9. Cover the casserole with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
10. Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and bubbly.
11. Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
